BundleCapacityPolicy.description:
How a bundle draws on capacity, per channel where it differs: the capacity source, dedicated or shared and hard or soft allocation, the ceiling, how long a hold lasts, the booking cut-off, and whether overbooking or a waitlist is allowed (Capacity Pool & Reservation Manager; Bundle Availability by Channel, Venue & Partner). The capacity itself is the catalogue's (`catalogue.channel_capacity`, `catalogue.inventory_hold`). A row with no channel is the bundle's default. (DM5, 29 September: data model for the agreed operations)
**Written by setBundleCapacityPolicy; read by listBundleCapacityPolicies, listCapacityPoolReservation and listBundleAvailabilityChannel** (decided 29 September, writers pass).

venueId.description: Where the policy differs by venue for a multi-venue bundle.

holdDurationMinutes.description: How long a temporary reservation of the components lasts.

bookingCutoffMinutes.description: Minutes before the experience after which the bundle is no longer sold.
